text: Implemented IdtParameters/EkParameters, RecordingMethod and descriptor factories, typed parameter descriptors and versioned recording codecs. Nine new portable tests cover independent stationary/five-point event support, direct/interpreted/restored equality, axis/minimum sensitivity, exact long durations, malformed parameters, method/schema refusal, regular-sampling failure and degree-versus-pixel compile rejection. Focused JVM/JS tests and executable guide pass. Deliberate etaX encoder corruption killed by two tests; restored source SHA256 6046b1714dde14c5790b98ff8d5b429680e3e8b909225c2d89e8bf062e5adc70. Full gates in progress; no hidden EK threshold fit or new detector algorithm.
